description: Department of Archaeology - Order made to declare the monuents which specified in the Schedule to the Order published in Gaz. No. 1919 of 12.06.2015 as 'Protected Monuments'
reasoning: This gazette content is an order under the Antiquities Ordinance declaring specific monuments as "Protected Monuments." It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create legal protections for cultural heritage sites, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister by name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal protections rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
